cohort: 44,539 mother-child pairs from the Massachusetts General Hospital Maternal Child Cohort (MMCC) of children born between 1998 and 2016
finding: Children born by cesarean delivery without labor had a higher risk of celiac disease compared to children born vaginally.
mod_finding: The adjusted hazard ratio (aHR) of caesarean delivery for CD was 1.39 (95% CI: 0.99, 1.96, p = 0.06) when compared to children born vaginally.
